gate.threshold_basis: design requirements (same-exemplar identity, class coverage, identity rotation) + paired-stats target minimum; NOT expected accuracy
gate.verification_source: human review bookkeeping only; assistant drafts never verified

target_selection.frame: unused development claims in fully-unused leakage groups (outputs/m16-partitions-v1)
excluded_unconditionally: claims whose leakage group intersects DEV50
target_selection.class_source: frozen non-learned heuristic of the M1.6.2 triage lineage (no gold, no learned router)
target_selection.ordering: count-then-ID: per covered class, ascending sample_id ordinal

assignment.rule: within-class rank i receives class exemplar at position i mod pool_size

stats.interpretation: exploratory only; positive signal justifies Tier-2 planning, never M1.6.3 activation

environment_lock.single_retrieval_pass_for_new_population: step-4 only, requires Tier-1 + human authorization
